Q: How to separate variables on each line in a batch SET statement? A:

please refer to the code comments and links contained to learn how this works

@echo off & cls
Setlocal EnableExtensions

Set "data=%%computername%%, %%number_of_Processors%%, %%programData%%"

Setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion
rem https://www.dostips.com/forum/viewtopic.php?t=6429
rem archive of the above - https://archive.is/8NA5T

rem expand literal string. unsafe for strings containing batch poison characters
rem splits on ", " and injects new echo command. This works because substring
rem substitution is succeptable to command injection.
Echo(%data:, =&Echo(%
rem initiate extra parsing phase using Call to expand variables contained within a variable.
Call Echo(%data:, =& call Echo(%

rem https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/console/console-virtual-terminal-sequences
rem below defines escape char for Virtual Terminal Sequencing. requires Windows 10 build 10586 or newer
for /f %%e in ('echo prompt $E^|cmd.exe') do set \e=%%e
Echo(
Set column=0
<nul set /p=%data:, =& set /a "column+=25" & <nul set /p .=!\E![!column!G%
Echo(
Set column=0
Call <nul set /p=%data:, =& set /a "column+=25" & call <nul set /p .=!\E![!column!G%
Echo(
Echo(
Echo(%\e%7%data:, =& Echo(%
Echo(
Call <nul set /p=%\e%8%\e%[25G%data:, =& call <nul set /p .=!\E![1B!\E![25G%
Echo(
Pause
Endlocal

Q: Unable to resolve "../../App" from "node_modules\expo\AppEntry.js" Failed building JavaScript bundle A:

I had similar issue, and I fixed it by installing 'expo-keep-awake' and 'react-native-unimodules' by using 'npm install react-native-unimodules' and 'npm install expo-keep-awake'.

According to this page, you should ensure that react-native-unimodules is installed when using the expo-keep-awake.

Hope this is helpful to you :)
